$comment: Run O1 lane K1, set which: Which One Piece character are you, written by us (owner, 2026-10-26). Arc 0, scope both. Eight questions about the reader with a sea voyage flavour and no story detail. Six profiles, all spoiler level 0 characters of docs/anime/data/series/one-piece.json (Makino and Koby were added to the series file, first arc). Facts cited: monkey-d-luffy: one-piece-luffy-carefree-071, one-piece-luffy-loyal-captain-072, one-piece-luffy-stomach-061; roronoa-zoro: one-piece-zoro-train-or-nap-073, one-piece-zoro-loyalty-075, one-piece-zoro-strong-drinker-076, one-piece-zoro-direction-074; shanks: one-piece-shanks-mentor-077, one-piece-shanks-straw-hat-078, one-piece-shanks-lost-arm-079, one-piece-shanks-own-crew-080; gol-d-roger: one-piece-roger-treasure-026, one-piece-roger-treasure-open-081; makino: one-piece-makino-bartender-083, one-piece-makino-raised-luffy-084; koby: one-piece-koby-first-friend-086, one-piece-koby-chore-boy-087, one-piece-koby-escape-088.

questions.question: You are handed a small boat and a free week at sea. What do you load first?

options.text: A mountain of food and no map
Training gear and a sunny spot for a nap
A clever clue to a prize nobody has found yet
Cups, a kettle and room for company

questions.question: A kid tells you they dream of setting off across the sea. You:

options.text: Give them something precious to keep them going
Say go for it, and offer to come along as a friend
Feed them well and wave them off with a smile
Admit you wish you had that kind of nerve

questions.question: How do you spend a long, free afternoon?

options.text: Training until the light fades
Stirring up some fun with no plan at all
Quietly tidying up for everyone else
Telling a story about the biggest adventure you can imagine

questions.question: You get lost on the way to a friend's house. What now?

options.text: Keep walking, fully sure this is the right road
Ask a stranger, then end up chatting for an hour
Turn back and double check, then apologise for being late
Take the long way gladly, it is an excuse for an adventure

questions.question: Your friends are stuck in a tight spot. Which role do you take?

options.text: The calm one who keeps everyone steady
The one who charges in first
The one who trained for exactly this day
The one who makes sure everybody is fed and in good spirits

questions.question: Which compliment would mean the most to you?

options.text: You always knew the right moment to step back
Everyone feels safe around you
You never gave up on a friend
You inspired me to try something big

questions.question: Pick your drink for the evening.

options.text: Something strong, and I will not even feel it
Whatever is going, next to a huge plate of meat
Just tea and a good chat
A toast to the future with the whole room

questions.question: What would you most like to leave behind one day?

options.text: A hidden prize that someone has to find to earn
A friend with a brighter future than mine
A warm seat and a good memory
A story about the day I took a chance

profile: You are cheerful and carefree, and you rarely stop to worry about what comes next.
You are loyal to your friends, and you make new ones wherever you go.
Mealtimes matter to you, and your stomach has a vote in most decisions.
You are happiest training for a big goal or napping in the sun.
You are loyal to the people you respect, and you can hold your drink better than most.
Your sense of direction is a running joke among your friends.
You are the mentor people remember, the one who gave them something to carry for life.
You would give up a lot to keep a kid safe, and you captain a crew of your own.
You leave something so big behind that people set sail to find it.
You would leave your greatest treasure where anyone could take it, as long as they find it first.
You keep the cups full and the lights on for everyone who walks through the door.
You have a way of looking after kids long before they set off to see the world.
You are the kind of friend who turns up first and means a lot to the one you stand beside.
You may start out stuck doing everyone else's chores, but the right friend can change your course.
